facts.fact: Lata's crown-leaf page burned at her naming to Usha in ch30, so three crown leaves remain in ch31; two guards keep theirs and Sajan burns his, keeping the roll that confirms Sanu as his younger brother.

At first grey a lone stranger is seen climbing the pass road toward the watch-house; Kuttu sounds the horn. The Company's first vote as a chartered body, with the right to refuse the crown, is pending.
